meta.name: Port of Los Santos Harbor Courier Dispatch
meta.author: GTA-Anything Clean-Room
meta.description: On-duty/off-duty Port of Los Santos commercial courier dispatch loop: go on duty via static metadata menu -> stream mule/benson service truck & dock coordinator NPC -> receive dispatch callout -> drive to inspection zones -> interact with coordinator -> resolve callout -> clean off-duty WorldSession teardown.

states.name: Idle
states.description: Off-duty standby, waiting for LeftControl+F10 dispatch terminal hotkey.

states.name: MenuSelecting
states.description: Reviewing harbor dispatch manifest and truck class via static metadata cards without spawning 3D vehicles.

states.name: ResourceStreaming
states.description: Streaming mule/benson service vehicle and dock coordinator NPC models with timeout release and vanilla fallback.

states.name: SpawningShift
states.description: Spawning service truck at Elysian Logistics Yard, verifying non-null handle, registering lease in WorldSession, and assigning dispatch callout.

states.name: ActiveDispatch
states.description: Driving service vehicle to inspection zones, holding in customs bay, interacting with NPC coordinator, and resolving callouts.

states.name: DispatchSummary
states.description: Displaying resolved callout count and harbor clearance payout before off-duty cleanup.

states.name: Teardown
states.description: Going off duty and invoking WorldSession.DisposeAll() to release leased truck, coordinator NPCs, blips, and model handles.

evidence.extracted_fact: On-duty/off-duty dispatch operational loop: go on duty -> receive dispatch callout -> drive mule/benson service vehicle to inspection zone -> interact with NPC coordinator -> resolve callout -> go off duty with clean entity teardown.
4 Port of Los Santos dispatch inspection zones (Elysian Staging Yard, Pier 400 Customs Bay, Terminal Gantry Crane, South Port Clearance Gate) with $120 callout reward.
